findings.title: Stats request that hangs never times out; page shows 'Loading stats…' forever
findings.steps: Open /stats, make /api/stats/harvests hang (browser_route with no response), change the From date, wait 14 s.
findings.expected: Request aborts after 10 s and an error with a retry option appears.
findings.actual: Still 'Loading stats…' after 14 s; no timeout is set on useApiFetch.
findings.evidence: Page text after 14 s: '... This year\n\nLoading stats…'

findings.title: Error state has no retry button
findings.steps: Make /api/stats/harvests return 500 (HTML body), change the From date. Restore the API.
findings.expected: Error message plus a Try again button that reloads the stats once the server is back.
findings.actual: Only 'Could not load harvest stats.' is shown, with no retry control. The only way to recover is to change a date or reload; re-entering the same date does nothing.
findings.evidence: Buttons in main after failure: ['This year'] only; after unrouting and re-filling the same date the error stayed.

findings.title: Non-JSON 200 response crashes the render: stale results stay up with a stuck 'Loading stats…'
findings.steps: Open /stats, route /api/stats/harvests to 200 with text/html body '<html>proxy</html>', change the From date.
findings.expected: An error saying the stats could not be read.
findings.actual: Render throws 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' (stats.plants on a string). The page keeps the previous range's Best plants and table under a permanent 'Loading stats…', so old data looks like the new range's results.
findings.evidence: Console TypeError at stats.vue render; page text shows 'Loading stats…' followed by the old Best plants list.

findings.title: Null/missing fields in the stats response render as blank or broken tables, or crash
findings.steps: Route /api/stats/harvests to 200 JSON with months:null, top_plants:null, plant_name:null, monthly_grams:null, total_grams:null, date_from:null, then change a date.
findings.expected: Response is validated and treated as an error; the page is never half-rendered.
findings.actual: The page renders an empty 'Best plants' section, '– total', 'Harvest weight per plant and month, – to –', and a plant row with an empty name. A Vue render error is also thrown and the page stays on 'Loading stats…'.
findings.evidence: Page text: 'Loading stats… Best plants Weight by plant and month – total ... PLANT TOTAL – Total –'

findings.title: Clearing the From field silently falls back to 1 Jan of this year, giving a misleading error
findings.steps: Set To = 2025-12-31 (valid with From=2025-...), then clear the From field.
findings.expected: A blank From either means 'no lower bound' or shows a field-level message that From is required.
findings.actual: The client omits 'from', so the server uses 2026-01-01. The page shows 'The From date must be on or before the To date.' while the From field looks empty. Opening the resulting URL (?to=2025-12-31) directly shows the same error.
findings.evidence: URL became /stats?to=2025-12-31; page text 'The From date must be on or before the To date.'

findings.title: Months without harvests are left out of the per-month table
findings.steps: GET /api/stats/harvests?from=0001-01-01&to=9999-12-31 (or choose a range of several years in the UI).
findings.expected: Per-month totals across the chosen range, with empty months shown as 0/–, so columns are contiguous.
findings.actual: Only months that have harvests become columns (e.g. 2025-08 then 2026-06), which hides the gap and makes the timeline misleading.

findings.title: Long plant names are cut off with an ellipsis in Best plants and the dashboard with no way to read them
findings.where: /stats Best plants cards, dashboard 'Top plant this year' card (375 px)
findings.steps: Create a plant named 'Supercalifragilisticexpialidociousbeanstalkwithaverylongnamethatneverbreaks', log a harvest, then view /stats at 375 px.
findings.expected: The full name is readable (wrapped, or available as a tooltip).
findings.actual: Shown as 'Supercalifragilis…' with no title attribute. The table's nowrap row header also makes the plant column as wide as the screen, pushing every month column off-screen.
